causes.label: The mains plug of the power cord is not plugged in.
remedies: Connect the appliance to the power supply.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "The mains plug of the power cord is not plugged in."

causes.label: The circuit breaker in the fuse box has tripped.
remedies: Check the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "The circuit breaker in the fuse box has tripped."

causes.label: There has been a power cut.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your room or other appliances are working.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "There has been a power cut."

causes.label: Malfunction
remedies: Switch off the fuse in the fuse box.
Switch the fuse back on after approx. 10 seconds.
If the fault was a one-off, the message disappears.

causes.label: Demo mode is activated.
remedies: Briefly disconnect the appliance from the power supply by switching the circuit
breaker in the fuse box off and then on again.
Deactivate demo mode within 5 minutes by changing the basic setting        to .
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "Demo mode is activated."

symptoms.symptom: Food takes longer than usual to heat up.

causes.label: The microwave power setting was too low.
remedies: Select a higher microwave power setting.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "The microwave power setting was too low."

causes.label: You have placed a larger amount of food than normal in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "You have placed a larger amount of food than normal in the appliance."

causes.label: Double the amount needs double the cooking time. The food was colder than usual.
remedies: Stir or turn the food during cooking.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "Double the amount needs double the cooking time. The food was colder than usual."

causes.label: The door was not fully closed.
remedies: Check whether food residue or debris is trapped in the door.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "The door was not fully closed."
